Summary.en: Applies a functionality (or attribute changes) to a target element while a comparison between a watched field's value and a date reference holds; re-evaluates on every change. Use it instead of hiddenif for ordering comparisons (after/before, older/younger, more/less than) on date/time/number values.
Summary.de: Wendet eine Funktionalität (oder Attributänderungen) auf ein Zielelement an, solange ein Vergleich zwischen dem Wert eines beobachteten Felds und einer Datumsreferenz erfüllt ist; wird bei jeder Änderung neu ausgewertet. Statt hiddenif für Ordnungsvergleiche (nach/vor, älter/jünger, mehr/weniger als) bei Datums-/Zeit-/Zahlenwerten verwenden.
Summary.it: Applica una funzionalità (o modifiche agli attributi) a un elemento di destinazione finché è soddisfatto un confronto tra il valore di un campo osservato e un riferimento data; viene rivalutato a ogni modifica. Usarlo al posto di hiddenif per confronti di ordine (dopo/prima, più vecchio/giovane, più/meno di) su valori di data/ora/numero.

Parameter.Reference: The threshold the watched value is compared with. It MUST resolve to a JavaScript Date, never a plain string: write the Date.FromString element placeholder, e.g. { Date.FromString > 01.06.2026 ; DD.MM.YYYY } (or { Date.Today }). A literal 01.06.2026 has no getTime() and breaks the comparison.
Parameter.Mode: GT (after/later/greater), GTEQ (on/after/at least), LT (before/earlier/less), LTEQ (on/before/at most), EQ (exactly) or NEQ (not equal). The enum values are GTEQ/LTEQ - GTE/LTE are invalid.
Parameter.Target: The element whose attributes are changed - a dot-prefixed CLASS selector (e.g. .coSpaetbucherHinweis). Candidate and target MUST share the same container/fieldset; never use an #id selector.
Parameter.DateFormat: The format of the CANDIDATE's value (datatype dateDE -> DD.MM.YYYY, native date -> YYYY-MM-DD). Omit it for non-date values.
Parameter.Candidate: The element whose value is watched - a dot-prefixed CLASS selector (e.g. .tfKursbeginn, its own name when the tagged field is the watched one); never an #id selector.

Reference.default: A JavaScript Date (use { Date.FromString > <date> ; <format> } or { Date.Today }); a literal date string breaks the comparison.

Mode.default: GT (after/later/greater), GTEQ (on/after/at least), LT (before/earlier/less), LTEQ (on/before/at most), EQ (exactly), NEQ (not equal).

Target.default: Dot-prefixed CLASS selector of the element to change, resolved in the watched field's container (never an #id selector).

DateFormat.default: Format of the candidate's value (dateDE -> DD.MM.YYYY, native date -> YYYY-MM-DD); omit for non-date values.

Candidate.default: Dot-prefixed CLASS selector of the watched field (never an #id selector).
